Title: Test 4

Characters

* Maya: 9 years, a girl in a red frock
* Kabir: 12 years, a boy in a blue hoodie
* Grandpa: 70 years, white kurta and glasses

Locations

* the kitchen: a stove, pots and a fridge
* the garden: roses, a bench and a small pond

Props

* cookie jar: a glass jar of cookies

Script starts

Scene One: the kitchen - Morning

(Maya climbs on a chair to reach the cookie jar.)

Maya (whispering): «Just one cookie, nobody will know.»

Grandpa (smiling): "I know, little one!"

(Maya laughs and gives him a cookie.)

Scene Two: the garden - Afternoon

(Kabir and Maya sit on the bench.)

Kabir: «Look, a frog in the pond!»

Maya (surprised): "It is so tiny!"
